harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C10 native exit-status recheck route end to end: build a real mumei.native-bundle/v1, run `python -m agent native-exit-status-recheck` so the byte-identical reproduced program executes once and its OS exit status matches the record pin, then show a wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_exit_status_recheck/src/main.mm (the bounded native profile atom main() -> i64 requires: true).
Step 1 runs `native-bundle build` and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the trusted-channel build ID.
Step 2 runs the declared `native-exit-status-recheck` route and asserts report.exit_status_recheck == 'reproduced' plus the discharged-check partition.
Step 3 reruns the route with a wrong build ID and asserts no claimed outcome, full C02/runtime checks_not_performed and normalized exit_code 1.

name: Declared Native Exit-Status Recheck (native-exit-status-recheck)
description: C02/C10 exit-status recheck demo: the declared `native-exit-status-recheck` route runs `native-bundle recheck-exit-status` as one attempt — `exit_status_recheck: reproduced` plus `artifact_semantics` + `claim_truth` + `os_exit_status_observation` discharged checks on a clean run; the other runtime checks stay unperformed, and a wrong build ID leaves the full C02/runtime family unperformed.

narrative.before: The declared route boundary has not yet been checked.
narrative.after: Only the route's declared fields are checked; broader guarantees are not claimed.
narrative.moment: Exit-status pin reproduced; wrong build ID selects nothing.

result_message: Result: Bounded recheck; wrong build ID claims nothing.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared native-exit-status-recheck route executing a real bundle's byte-identical reproduced program once and matching its OS exit status against the record pin, then refusing to claim an outcome for a wrong build ID.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-exit-status-recheck-report/v1 with exit_status_recheck == 'reproduced', discharged_checks == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'os_exit_status_observation'] and checks_not_performed == ['file_identity', 'freshness', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'producer_authenticity', 'runtime_observation_semantics', 'semantic_correspondence'] and a non-null selected_result

wrong_report.json carries no exit_status_recheck or discharged_checks, checks_not_performed == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'os_exit_status_observation', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'producer_authenticity', 'runtime_observation_semantics', 'semantic_correspondence'], no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

steps.name: Produce a real native bundle via the Core
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_exit_status_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the declared member set is complete.

steps.name: native-exit-status-recheck reports reproduced + discharged checks
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-exit-status-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_exit_status_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-exit-status-recheck-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['exit_status_recheck']=='reproduced', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'os_exit_status_observation'], r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['file_identity', 'freshness', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'producer_authenticity', 'runtime_observation_semantics', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; print('native-exit-status-recheck: reproduced, artifact_semantics + claim_truth + os_exit_status_observation discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-exit-status-recheck-report/v1 with exit_status_recheck reproduced and discharged artifact_semantics + claim_truth + os_exit_status_observation; other runtime checks remain unperformed.
steps.verifier_gate: native-exit-status-recheck exits 0; the reproduced program's OS exit status matched the record pin.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-exit-status-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_exit_status_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-exit-status-recheck-report/v1'; assert 'exit_status_recheck' not in r; assert 'discharged_checks' not in r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'os_exit_status_observation', 'os_stderr_observation', 'os_stdout_observation', 'producer_authenticity', 'runtime_observation_semantics', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') == 1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: no claimed outcome, exit 1')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json holds no exit_status_recheck or discharged_checks, full C02/runtime checks_not_performed, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1.
steps.verifier_gate: The mismatched build ID exits 1, conflating mismatch with static failure — no claimed outcome.
